errors.text_span: без да се правят сравнения или интерпретации за причинно-следствени връзки между тях
errors.evidence: This clause offers an interpretation of the chart's limitations (causation) rather than describing its visual content. The statement 'без да се правят сравнения' (without making comparisons) is also inaccurate, as the chart's purpose is comparison, and the description itself makes comparisons in the previous sentence.
